tooltips.apiKey: Slug used in the webhook URL: /api/v1/CalCom/receive/{apiKey}. Register this URL in cal.com → Settings → Webhooks. Must be unique.
tooltips.signingSecret: Cal.com webhook secret. If set, the X-Cal-Signature-256 header is required and verified (HMAC-SHA256 of the body). Strongly recommended in production.
tooltips.createContactIfMissing: When enabled, creates a new Contact if the attendee email isn't found. Otherwise the webhook is skipped.
tooltips.metaCapiDataset: Optional. If set, events are forwarded to the Meta Conversions API using this dataset. If empty, the webhook only creates/updates the Contact (useful for CRM hygiene without ad tracking).
tooltips.metaCapiEventMapping: JSON mapping cal.com triggerEvent → Meta event_name. E.g. {"BOOKING_CREATED":"Schedule","BOOKING_CANCELLED":"","MEETING_ENDED":"Purchase"}. Empty or missing value = no CAPI forward for that trigger.
